content: 'Epɨrahini meta Manatsexi 'aixɨa kememu'itɨarie
Merikɨtsɨ 'arike Kutse katiniutamarieni kename paapaya rekuye. Hikɨ kaneyani yuniwema warawitɨtɨ Manatsexi 'Epɨrahini mame.
Kepauka Kakuwu mɨretima, waɨriyarika kananukuyerɨni yu'utatsie.
Kutse kaniutahɨawe mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Kakaɨyari Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye kaneniutahɨawe Rutsi kiekaritsie, Kanani kwieyaritsie. 'Aixɨa kaneniuyurieni,
mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Ne yanepɨtiyurieni waɨkawa tɨɨri pemɨwarayexeiyakɨ, pemɨtamɨirekɨ, 'anuiwaritsie yuwaɨkawatɨ nuiwarite mepayenexɨani. 'Ikɨ kwie yuheyemekɨ puwakwietɨni».
Merikɨte 'aniwema memuyuhuta 'Ekipitu pemɨwarayexei nekamatsitahɨawiwekaku 'akuxi, mepɨneniwematɨni. 'Epɨrahini Manatsexi yuheyeme mepɨneniwematɨni yaxeikɨa Xuweni meta Tsimehuni kememɨneteniwema.
Mɨkɨ wa'utɨmake pemɨwarayexeiya mepɨ'aniwematɨni, kwie memɨyetuiriyarienitsie wamatsikama mɨkɨta mana mepɨwayetuirieni.
Parani-'Arami ne'akunuaku, Xakeri 'amaama kanemɨni 'Epɨrata 'aurie, hikɨ Wereni mɨrakutewa, mɨkɨ huyeyari'utɨa tekaneikateuku, Kanani kwieyaritsie.
Hikɨ 'Ixaheri Kutse niwemama waruxeiyaka, mɨpaɨ katiniuta'iwauni: —¿Mɨkɨ temari kemɨ'ane mepɨyɨa?

Kutse yupaapa mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Mɨkɨ neniwema mepɨhɨkɨ Kakaɨyari mɨnetsiheyenɨ'airi 'ena memutinunuiwaxɨ. Hikɨ 'Ixaheri yuniwe mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —'Enahurawa keniwati'uitɨa nemɨyutanenewienikɨ wahetsiemieme.
'Ixaheri matsi kani'ukiratsitɨkaitɨniri, pɨkahaunierekairi. 'Ayumieme Kutse 'ahurawa kaniwati'uitɨani yuniwema. Paapaya kaniwaruti'itseni kaniwarutitapa.
Hikɨ Kutse mɨpaɨta katiniutahɨawe: —Neri tawarita nekamatsixeiyake nepɨne'eriekai. Matsi hikɨ Kakaɨyari pɨnetsi'upitɨa meta 'aniwemata nemɨwaxeiyakɨ.
Hikɨ Kutse yuniwema kaniwaranukuhapani yupaapa hɨxie, mɨkɨta kaniutihɨximakeni.

'Anukukeka yuniwe 'Epɨrahini yutseriekɨ kaniuwiya, yu'utakɨta Manatsexi. Hikɨ yupaapa hɨxie kaniwati'uitɨani, 'Epɨrahini 'etsimutewikaikɨ, yuteukari 'Ixaheri 'utata mutikenikɨ, Manatsexi mɨmatsikayatɨkaikɨ yuteukari tserieta mutikenikɨ.

Peru wateukari 'Ixaheri yutanenenewienike yumamate kaniupataxɨani, 'Epɨrahini hetsɨa yutseriekɨ heimana kaneutimeni tsepa 'etsimutewikai, Manatsexi hetsɨata yu'utata miemekɨ pɨtiunakixɨ tsepa mɨmatsikayatɨkai.
Kanitsutɨani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ:
Hikɨ Kutse pɨka'inakixɨ yupaapa xeiyatɨ, 'Epɨrahini mutayatsie meutimekaikɨ yutseriekɨ. Yupaapa mamaya 'uwiyaka, kanipata Manatsexi hetsie pɨta,
mɨpaɨ rehɨawetɨ: —Nepaapa, tixaɨ mɨpaɨ neniwe 'amɨyumate, Manatsexi pɨhɨkɨ. 'Atserieta miemekɨ mana pɨta keneutime'i.

Perutsɨ paapaya yapɨkatiutanaki'eri. Mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe yuniwe: —Ne nepɨtimate Manatsexi kiekarieya mariwetɨ kanayeimɨkɨ, matsi mutaya pɨta waɨkawa kanitaxiɨmɨkɨ, nuiwaritemama kiekari makate mekanakɨnikuni.
Mɨkɨ tukaritsie Kakuwu 'aixɨa kaniwaruyurieni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ:
Mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka, 'Ixaheri 'Epɨrahini mexɨakame kanayeitɨani 'arike Manatsexi.
Hikɨ 'imatɨrieka 'Ixaheri Kutse mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Pehurari nemɨmɨnikɨ, perutsɨ Kakaɨyari xehamatɨa kaniuyeikamɨkɨ, kanixe'akunuitɨamɨkɨ xeteukarima wakwietsie.
'Ekɨ Kutse 'a'iwama wahetsiemieme heitserie pepexeiya waɨkawa, nepɨmatsixatɨa Tsikeni
kwieyari, 'amuxeutsixi teɨteriyari nemɨwarunawairi newakwinetɨ.

footnotes.text: Tsikeni. Kiekari panuyɨne hɨri meta naipari.
